label: akinete
definition: A morphology trait in which a filamentous cyanobacterium differentiates enlarged, thick-coated, spore-like dormant cells called akinetes that can germinate into vegetative cells.
observations: Filamentous cyanobacterial akinete dormant-cell trait; absent from live METPO except for deprecated akinete classes, including METPO:1000012 obsolete akinete, and distinct from heterocysts and endospores.
